newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm, light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm, light test - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers had a firm undertone in a light test, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs few 71.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs few 71.00
Carcass basis steers and heifers also had a firm undertone in a light test.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs few 112.00-112.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs few 112.00-112.50. Reported sales for Wed - 400 Week to Date- 4,800
